title: When a Late Fee Arises on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit Statement
content:
**Cardholder agreement — late payment (Ridgeline Consumer Credit).**

1. A late fee posts on the day after a payment due date when the payments credited from the statement date through the due date total less than that statement's minimum payment due. It references the statement and carries that statement's period.
2. No late fee is charged when the minimum payment due was 0.00, and a payment later returned unpaid does not count as credited.
3. At most one late fee is charged for any one statement period. Whether a late fee already stands for a period is read from the account's ledger: a late fee line on the same account carrying the same statement period.
4. *Amount clause — no longer in force.* The former clause under which the late fee was the tier's repeat late fee when a late fee had been charged in the statement periods of the repeat-fee lookback before the period concerned, and the tier's first late fee otherwise, limited on a capped tier to the lower of that figure and the statement's minimum payment due, is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current Ridgeline Consumer Credit late fee amount basis.

Clauses 1 to 3 remain in force.

## Occurrence cases (hypothetical statements)

| Minimum payment due | Payments credited from statement date through due date | Late fee for the period |
|---|---|---|
| 60.00 | 40.00 | owed |
| 60.00 | 60.00 | not owed under clause 1 |
| 60.00 | 75.00 | not owed under clause 1 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | none (minimum was 0.00) |
| 60.00 | 60.00, later returned unpaid by the bank | owed (the returned payment does not count) |
| 60.00 | 10.00, and a late fee already stands for that period | no second late fee |

A payment credited the day after the due date does not count toward the minimum of that statement for this test.

superseded_clauses: The fee is late_fee_repeat_usd when card_msr_late_fees_lookback_cycles (late fees in the late_fee_repeat_lookback_cycles statement periods before this one) is one or more, and late_fee_first_usd otherwise; when late_fee_capped_at_min_due is true the fee is the lower of that amount and the statement's minimum payment due.
